image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a metallic disk brake rotor mounted on a vehicle hub. The rotor is silver with visible machining marks and cross-drilled holes near the outer edge. It features large circular cutouts for weight reduction and cooling. The center shows the wheel hub assembly with lug studs. There is no visible caliper or brake pads in this specific frame; only the rotor and hub are clearly depicted. Background includes blurred mechanical components of the suspension/axle.
